items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: but I played at the country club with Percy.

ctx.x: You played for the fraternities up at Tulane University? Yeah, I played. The fraternity houses.
I played with, in fact, Houston there, but I played at the country club with Percy. I played.

Oh yeah, this is that homemade record. Oh yes, I'd like to hear this. Is that composed by Amos White? Yeah. Yeah. I was wondering some more about the Louis Dumaine records. Do you remember just where they were made?
